headings.usage: Primary large headings, elegant titles. Tracking should be tight (tracking-tighter).

accent_italic.usage: Inline italic accents inside headings, decorative elements.

body.usage: All paragraph text, UI text, labels. Tracking normal to relaxed.

mono.usage: Overlines, dates, code blocks, technical stats. MUST use uppercase and wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]).

visual_enhancers.grain_overlay: Fixed SVG noise overlay spanning viewport, pointer-events-none, mix-blend-multiply, opacity-50. Implementation: absolute inset-0 with an SVG pattern.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid var(--line) or var(--line-strong), no generic shadows, rely on contrast.

grids_layouts.philosophy: High asymmetry, 'Bento' Grid Mode A, generous negative space. Center-aligned text ONLY for very deliberate artistic moments, otherwise left-aligned.
grids_layouts.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24, p-32, p-48, p-64. Containers with border must use internal p-8 or p-12.
grids_layouts.grid_examples: 1x2, 2x3 OS cards, 4x3 capabilities with cursor spotlight, asymmetric 3D tilt grids for projects.

motion_interactions.smooth_scroll: Lenis.js for momentum scrolling. Add 'weight' to the scroll feel.
motion_interactions.cursor_spotlight: Track mouse position in wrapper, update background radial-gradient(circle at x y, rgba(255,90,31,0.1) 0%, transparent 80%).
motion_interactions.card_tilt: Framer-motion useMotionValue, useTransform for subtle rotateX/rotateY on hover.
motion_interactions.marquee: react-fast-marquee or framer-motion infinite loop. The 'Kinetic Texture' approach.
motion_interactions.parallax: Use scroll() and useTransform() from framer-motion for drifting hero orbs and slow scroll elements.

components_and_sections.sticky_navigation: Glassmorphic (bg-[#fbf9f4]/70, backdrop-blur-xl). Shrinks y-padding on scroll. Pill-shaped links.
components_and_sections.hero_section: Full viewport (h-screen). Drifting gradient orbs in background (blur-3xl). Floating stats cards with soft shadow.
components_and_sections.infinite_marquee: Black background (#0f0e0d), cream text (#fbf9f4), bold Fraunces mixed with Instrument Serif. Seamless loop.
components_and_sections.about_os: Paper bg (#fbf9f4), 2x3 grid. Bento style cards.
components_and_sections.capabilities: 4x3 grid. Mouse tracking spotlight on borders. Highlight the structural grid.
components_and_sections.featured_projects: Asymmetric grid. Cards tilt on hover. Projects: Mirsonics.com, Innofjoy.com, Damage Culture, The Hollow Vale, AI/Automation.
components_and_sections.project_modal: AnimatePresence full-screen overlay. Detailed content inside paper-colored panel.
components_and_sections.results_dashboard: 3-column KPI cards. SVGs that animate via framer-motion pathLength when in view.
components_and_sections.process_timeline: 6-step horizontal line with an active 'fill' indicator.
components_and_sections.the_lab: 4x2 grid of experiments. Status pills (Geist Mono, uppercase, small, tracked out).
components_and_sections.testimonials: 3-column quote cards, italic Fraunces for the quotes.
components_and_sections.contact_form: PRESERVE EXISTING LOGIC. Redesign visual layer only. Form fields must map exactly to current backend.
components_and_sections.footer: 4-column setup. Massive 'watermark' text at bottom (text-[15vw] Fraunces).

media.strategy: SVG-based visuals. NO external images as per spec. Use geometric shapes, path animations, and Phosphor/Lucide icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: PRESERVE all backend APIs, form logic, auth, and dashboard logic exactly as they are.
USE JS instead of TS. The project is Vite + React + Tailwind + JS.
Implement the UI directly using Tailwind CSS and standard React components.
Ensure the contact form logic uses existing React states and POSTs correctly.
Use named exports for components, default exports for pages.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop'. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (`transition: all`). This breaks transforms. Apply specific transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp buttons with interaction animations.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...).
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...}).
